name: Prototype E-Web
description: The Prototype E-Web was a modified E-Web heavy repeating blaster cannon utilized by the Hunter Sentinel as he competed in the Grand Arena. It was tinkered and modified by another Hunter, Dizzy. Its capabilities included a combat shield, and a Suppressing Shot which could stun opponents.
